an3.39:1.2: mama sudaṃ bhikkhave pitu nivesane pokkharaṇiyo kāritā honti
an3.39:1.3: ekattha sudaṃ bhikkhave uppalaṃ vappati ekattha padumaṃ ekattha puṇḍarīkaṃ yāvadeva mamatthāya.
an3.39:1.4: na kho panassāhaṃ bhikkhave kāsikaṃ candanaṃ dhāremi kāsikaṃ su me taṃ bhikkhave veṭhanaṃ hoti kāsikā kañcukā kāsikaṃ nivāsanaṃ kāsiko uttarāsaṅgo.
an3.39:1.5: rattindivaṃ kho pana su me taṃ bhikkhave setacchattaṃ dhāriyati
an3.39:1.6: mā naṃ sītaṃ vā uṇhaṃ vā rajo vā tiṇaṃ vā ussāvo vāti.
an3.39:2.1: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ eko hemantiko eko gimhiko eko vassiko.
an3.39:2.2: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave vassike pāsāde vassike cattāro māse nippurisehi turiyehi paricāriyamāno na heṭṭhāpāsādaṃ orohāmi.
an3.39:2.3: yathā kho pana bhikkhave aññesaṃ nivesanesu dāsakammakaraporisassa kaṇājakaṃ bhojanaṃ dīyati bilaṅgadutiyaṃ evamevassu me bhikkhave pitu nivesane dāsakammakaraporisassa sālimaṃsodano dīyati.
an3.39:3.1: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave evarūpāya iddhiyā samannāgatassa evarūpena ca accantasukhumālena etadahosi
an3.39:3.2: assutavā kho puthujjano attanā jarādhammo samāno jaraṃ anatīto paraṃ jiṇṇaṃ disvā aṭṭiyati harāyati jigucchati attānaṃyeva atisitvā ahaṃpi khomhi jarādhammo jaraṃ anatīto
an3.39:3.3: ahañceva kho pana jarādhammo samāno jaraṃ anatīto paraṃ jiṇṇaṃ disvā aṭṭiyeyyaṃ harāyeyyaṃ jiguccheyyaṃ na metaṃ assa paṭirūpanti
an3.39:3.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave iti paṭisañcikkhato yo yobbane yobbanamado so sabbaso pahīyi.
an3.39:4.1: assutavā kho puthujjano attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhiṃ anatīto paraṃ byādhitaṃ disvā aṭṭiyati harāyati jigucchati attānaṃyeva atisitvā
an3.39:4.2: ahaṃpi khomhi byādhidhammo byādhiṃ anatīto ahañceva kho pana byādhidhammo samāno byādhiṃ anatīto paraṃ byādhitaṃ disvā aṭṭiyeyyaṃ harāyeyyaṃ jiguccheyyaṃ na metaṃ assa paṭirūpanti
an3.39:4.3: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave iti paṭisañcikkhato yo ārogye ārogyamado so sabbaso pahīyi.
an3.39:5.1: assutavā kho puthujjano attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇaṃ anatīto paraṃ mataṃ disvā aṭṭiyati harāyati jigucchati attānaṃyeva atisitvā
an3.39:5.2: ahaṃpi khomhi maraṇadhammo maraṇaṃ anatīto ahañceva kho pana maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇaṃ anatīto paraṃ mataṃ disvā aṭṭiyeyyaṃ harāyeyyaṃ jiguccheyyaṃ na metaṃ assa paṭirūpanti
an3.39:5.3: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave iti paṭisañcikkhato yo jīvite jīvitamado so sabbaso pahīyīti.
an3.39:6.4: yobbanamadamatto vā bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.39:6.5: so kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
an3.39:6.7: jīvitamadamatto vā bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.39:6.8: so kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
an3.39:7.1: yobbanamadamatto vā bhikkhave bhikkhu sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati
an3.39:7.2: ārogyamadamatto vā bhikkhave bhikkhu sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati
an3.39:7.3: jīvitamadamatto vā bhikkhave bhikkhu sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattatīti.
